options_evaluated: Post-consumer recycled ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene) with structural ribbing
Virgin Polycarbonate (PC) for high impact resistance
decisions.conflict: Using recycled ABS reduces the material footprint but requires thicker walls and ribbing to match the impact strength of virgin PC, which increases the vacuum cleaner's weight and use-phase transport energy.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (h), page 79: use or content of recycled materials and recovery of materials
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (t), page 80: lightweight design as expressed through reduction of material consumption, load- and stress-optimisation of structures
decisions.chief_resolution: Select post-consumer recycled ABS with stress-optimized internal ribbing. This choice prioritizes the use of recycled content under Annex I (h) while utilizing stress-optimization under Annex I (t) to minimize weight increases.
decisions.design_action: Verify the mechanical property consistency and supply chain availability of high-grade post-consumer recycled ABS from certified European recyclers.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal inserts with standard Torx screws
decisions.conflict: Ultrasonic welding minimizes assembly time and part count but permanently bonds the housing, preventing non-destructive disassembly for repair or material recycling.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance, as expressed through compatibility with commonly available tools, ease of non-destructive disassembly and re-assembly
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (e), page 79: avoidance of technical solutions detrimental to reuse, upgrading, repair, maintenance, refurbishment, remanufacturing and recycling of products and components
decisions.chief_resolution: Specify threaded metal inserts with standard Torx screws. This ensures non-destructive disassembly and re-assembly as mandated by Annex I (b) and avoids permanent welds that are detrimental to repair and recycling under Annex I (e).
decisions.design_action: Investigate the spatial layout of the housing to verify that all screw joint locations are accessible using standard, non-specialized tools.

options_evaluated: High-efficiency brushless DC (BLDC) motor with neodymium magnets
Synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM) without permanent magnets
decisions.conflict: A neodymium-based BLDC motor maximizes use-phase energy efficiency but relies on critical raw materials with high environmental extraction footprints and low recycling rates.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (g), page 79: use or consumption of energy, water and other resources in one or more life cycle stages
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (h), page 79: use or content of recycled materials and recovery of materials, including critical raw materials
decisions.chief_resolution: Choose a high-efficiency BLDC motor designed with a modular rotor that allows the permanent magnets to be easily slid out and separated. This balances energy efficiency (Annex I (g)) with critical raw material recovery (Annex I (h)).
decisions.design_action: Verify the feasibility of a modular rotor design that allows the permanent magnets to be mechanically extracted without destroying the rotor assembly.

options_evaluated: Active cooling fan integrated into the main motor shaft
Passive heat sinks with extensive ventilation slots
Encapsulated phase change materials (PCMs) around the motor housing
decisions.conflict: Passive cooling via extensive ventilation slots reduces energy use and noise but increases the risk of fine dust ingress, which degrades motor reliability and shortens the product's lifetime.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product or its components as expressed through technical lifetime, resistance to stresses or ageing mechanisms
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (q), page 80: emissions to air, water or soil released in one or more lifecycle stages of the product, including noise
decisions.chief_resolution: Implement an active cooling fan integrated into the motor shaft, combined with an upstream washable pre-filter. This maintains thermal reliability (Annex I (a)) while optimizing airflow to minimize noise emissions (Annex I (q)).
decisions.design_action: Check filter classification standards to verify that the pre-filter can capture motor-damaging particulates without causing an excessive pressure drop.

options_evaluated: Modular cassette-based architecture (separate motor, battery, and filtration modules)
decisions.conflict: A modular cassette-based architecture significantly improves ease of repair and component replacement but increases the total volume, weight, and initial material footprint of the vacuum cleaner.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance, as expressed through characteristics, availability, delivery time and affordability of spare parts, modularity
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (c), page 79: ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment as expressed through number of materials and components used
decisions.chief_resolution: Implement a modular cassette-based architecture for high-wear components (battery, motor, and filter). This directly satisfies Annex I (b) by utilizing modularity to facilitate rapid, toolless replacement of components prone to degradation.
decisions.design_action: Verify that the electrical and mechanical interfaces between the cassettes use standardized connectors to ensure future compatibility and ease of refurbishment.

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized Li-ion battery pack
decisions.conflict: A corded AC power supply eliminates battery-related hazardous waste and resource depletion but limits user mobility, potentially reducing the product's market appeal and functional versatility.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (g), page 79: use or consumption of energy, water and other resources in one or more life cycle stages
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (r), page 80: amounts of waste generated, including plastic waste... and amounts of hazardous waste generated
decisions.chief_resolution: Select a removable, standardized Li-ion battery pack. This avoids premature product obsolescence due to battery degradation, minimizing hazardous waste generation (Annex I (r)) while maintaining energy efficiency (Annex I (g)) through smart power management.
decisions.design_action: Check the availability of open-standard battery communication protocols to ensure the battery pack can be easily diagnosed and repurposed for second-life applications.
